style: Create original playful reactor-greenhouse game art with chunky hand-inked dark teal contours, flat gouache-like color masses and restrained dry-brush texture. Combine botanical shapes with improvised copper machinery and cream ceramics, using mint, lime, peach, coral and cyan accents over deep teal. Use bold readable silhouettes, two-step cel shading and selective warm ivory highlights; reserve soft emission for active energy and VFX. Keep the humor earnest and slightly ridiculous, with no imitation of existing game designs. Include no text, letters, numerals, labels, logos, watermarks or typographic symbols, and respect each asset's stated background and framing requirements.

assets.brief: Simple readable card frame (status skill)
assets.prompt: A clean, simple, flat trading-card frame template in the style of classic deckbuilder cards. Card body color: muted plum (#6B4A63) with a darker inner border (#48304A); ribbon in dark plum (#2F1F31) with a thin cream edge. ART WINDOW SHAPE: plain rectangle with small rounded corners. STRICT LAYOUT on a portrait card (width W, height H), flat front view, no perspective: the card body fills the whole canvas edge to edge with small rounded corners and a thin dark ink outline (#142C30). NAME RIBBON: a horizontal banner across the top from x=6% to x=94%, y=3% to y=14%, flat and empty in the middle (text is added later). COST SOCKET: an empty round socket centered at x=11%, y=8%, diameter 18% of W, overlapping the left end of the ribbon. ART WINDOW: x=12% to 88%, y=16% to 55%; fill the window interior with PURE FLAT MAGENTA #FF00FF (it will be cut out), with a clean frame border around it. TYPE TAG: a small flat dark plate centered at x=36%-64%, y=55%-61%, empty. TEXT PLATE: x=9% to 91%, y=63% to 95%, a FLAT LIGHT CREAM (#F3E8CF) panel with rounded corners and a thin border, completely plain and empty for dark text. Keep decoration minimal and flat: no vines, no leaves over the plates, no gadgets, no texture noise, no text. Background outside the card must be transparent.
